messages.subject: Students please check your time frame
parts:
Dear Students,

as one of you had to withdraw his application seeing that his schedule
in summer got too tight for GSoC:
please make sure that you really have the time to do the GSoC. If you
see problems, please let us know as soon as possible.

Best regards,

Claudia
